howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.heading:
Nodes are compartments.
Recipes are the box.
howItWorks.description: Each node encapsulates one capability: compress an image, rename a file, clean a CSV, download a video. Chain nodes into recipes that automate your workflow. Recipes are portable .bnto.json files that run everywhere: CLI, browser, desktop.

noCatch.label: No catch
noCatch.heading:
Free recipes that stay free.
Open source you can verify.
noCatch.description: No signup. No watermarks. No daily caps. The engine runs on your machine, so it costs nothing to operate. MIT licensed. Inspect the source, fork it, contribute. Build nodes for anything you want to automate.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: On your machine. The CLI runs natively on your system. The browser version uses Rust compiled to WebAssembly. Either way, your files are processed locally and never uploaded anywhere.
faq.a2: Yes. Every recipe is free, unlimited, forever. No signup, no watermarks, no quality reduction, no daily caps. The engine runs on your machine, so it costs nothing to operate.
faq.a3: Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, BMP, and TIFF for compression, resizing, and format conversion. Data: CSV files for cleaning and column renaming. Files: any file type for batch renaming. Video: download via yt-dlp (CLI only). More node types are coming.
faq.q4: Can I build my own recipes?
faq.a4: Yes. Recipes are .bnto.json files that compose nodes into multi-step pipelines. Chain a resize into a format conversion into a compression, all in one recipe. Share them as files or contribute them to the repo.
faq.a5: Yes. The entire engine, CLI, and web app are MIT licensed. You can inspect the source code, verify how recipes work, fork it, or contribute.
faq.a6: All recipes are free and unlimited. The engine runs on your machine. Managed cloud execution for server-side features may come later, but the core engine and CLI will always be free and open source.
faq.a7: Run cargo install bnto to install the CLI. Or use the browser version on this site, no install needed.
faq.q8: Can I process multiple files at once?
faq.a8: Yes. Pass multiple files to bnto run or drop them in the browser. bnto processes them all in a single batch.
